claim: The bridge network mode uses Docker's built-in virtual network on Linux inside each Amazon EC2 instance and is the default network mode on Linux if a network mode isn't specified in the task definition.
question: Which ECS network mode is the default on Linux when none is specified?

values.display: This is the default network mode on Linux if a network mode isn't specified in the task definition

qualifiers.scope: Amazon ECS tasks on Amazon EC2 Linux
qualifiers.condition: no network mode specified in the task definition
